text: Every change on this board is a journey.
Each letter sits on a wheel of forty flaps. It turns one way only.
From B back to A is one step. Here, it is thirty-nine.
asr: From be back to a is one step. Here, it is thirty-nine.

text: So when a train is late, the board writes the whole line again.
The last train leaves in ten seconds.
Even going back means going forward, all the way round.
